title: An Active Intrusion Campaign Against Check Point Security Management Servers
content: An active intrusion campaign targeting Check Point Security Management Servers has been identified, impacting at least 22 organizations globally between October 17th and November 2nd, 2026. title: Agentic Attacks in the Wild: ARTEX & Offensive AI Frameworks
content: Between late September and November 2026, cloud environments experienced a surge in automated intrusions driven by agentic offensive frameworks, particularly ARTEX and its variants including Cairn, CyberStrikeAI, and HexStrike. These attacks leverage AI-driven automation to conduct noisy, vector-agnostic campaigns that spray credentials, probe endpoints, and abuse multiple access methods... title: Vmcloudoor: a stealthy backdoor targeting the Chinese cloud
content: A sophisticated Linux implant called Vmcloudoor has been discovered targeting virtual machines hosted on Chinese cloud platforms, specifically Alibaba, Tencent, and Huawei. The backdoor disguises itself by mimicking legitimate cloud service processes and adapts its concealment profile based on the detected environment.
